gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Galaxy draws every letter as a smooth, tube-like line, spaced loosely with a dense, tall lowercase band. Noto Sans Hanunoo follows in a plain sans, filling the line with open-ended letters.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Smooth, flat-lined and cosmic. Galaxy keeps every stroke uniform with generous spacing, while Noto Sans Hebrew sets a sans body whose big midsection and wide curve gaps feel modern.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-hk: Galaxy's strokes never change weight, so it skims along. Noto Sans HK brings large lowercase forms and lifted brush ends, giving the pair a crisp, clean confidence.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-imperial-: Galaxy has a stencil-like flatness to every line. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic supplies approachable warmth through its pincer-like c and a short step up to capitals, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-inscripti: Galaxy runs one single stroke width through its whole alphabet, with a dense, tall lowercase band and loose spacing. It handles the commanding display moments, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian handles the quiet work with big open eyes.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-jp: Galaxy is monoline from stem to tip, with a dense, tall lowercase band and loose spacing. Noto Sans JP, a plain sans, sweeps its curves open across a tall x-height, so extended text moves along freely.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Cosmic and rounded, Galaxy has a wire-like stroke running through every letter with loose spacing. Noto Sans Kaithi brings an open-channeled e and lowercase that fills the line like capitals, a sans that feels contemporary and grounded.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Galaxy carries a commanding, cosmic look with no thick-thin pulse in any stroke, and loose spacing around each letter. Noto Sans Kannada is a plain sans that adds an approachable lift from small letters to capitals.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Galaxy draws a single constant stroke width, with a dense, tall lowercase band and loosely spaced letters. Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away before curves close, so a longer passage feels clean and unhurried.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-kharoshth: Galaxy's strokes look like thin plastic tubing bent in loops. Noto Sans Kharoshthi sets a thick, dark stripe of lowercase beneath it with curves that stay open, a contemporary sans-serif counterpart.
